sentences.text:
The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashing of proceeding impugned bearing Criminal Case No.54993/2021; State of U.P. vs. Vineet Verma and Other, FIR/
Crime No.0318/2020, Police Station Aashiyana, District-Lucknow under Section 498A/323/504/506/427/354(Ka) I.P.C. and Section 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act and charge sheet dated 01.07.2020 in Case Crime No.0318/2020, Police Station-Aashiyana, District-Lucknow under Section 498A/323/504/506/427/354(Ka) I.P.C. and Section 3, 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act with a further prayer to stay the proceedings of aforesaid case.

entities.text: State of U.P. vs. Vineet Verma and Other
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicants submits that the parties have entered into compromise outside the court and the matter has been settled between the parties.

Learned counsel for the applicants further submits that the compromise has been filed before the court below, but the same has not been verified, thus a positive direction be given to the court below to verify the contents of the compromise, so that the same may be filed before this Court and the proceeding of the case may be quashed.
Learned A.G.A. as well as learned Counsel for opposite party No.2 have no objection to the prayer made by the learned counsel for the applicants.

Accordingly, the present application is finally disposed of with a direction to the court below that if a compromise is already filed by the applicants before the court below and the parties appear, the contents of the compromise be verified in accordance with law within six weeks from today.
Certified copies annexed, if any, with this application be returned to the learned counsel for the applicants after keeping the photostat of the same on record.

Order Date :- 16.12.2023 Piyush/-
